verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an in-product 'AI Support Assistant' that users can consult as a first point of contact before opening a support ticket, which is a built-in AI assistant inside the product. However, evidence shows its scope is limited to support/troubleshooting Q&A rather than broader task delegation (e.g., configuring connectors, running transformations, managing syncs) — those agentic capabilities are instead exposed via the external Fivetran MCP server, not a built-in assistant. missing for 10: evidence of the built-in assistant performing actual operational tasks (not just answering support questions), broader scope beyond troubleshooting, and independent/hands-on confirmation of its usefulness.
